title: The Library Book Is Somewhere in There
caption:
Library day: the one morning the book we all saw on Sunday has moved.

It's under the couch. It's in the car. It's in the pocket we've already checked twice.

We'll find it. We always do.

Tag the co-parent who last saw the library book.
